topic: Helping others & pronoun traps it / one / some / any / mine（互相幫助＋代名詞陷阱 it / one / some / any / mine）

shadow.speaker: Tsai Ing-wen 蔡英文（2021 年 5 月 10 日以視訊在丹麥「哥本哈根民主高峰會」發表的英文演說，Alliance of Democracies 官方 YouTube）

chunks.text: Taiwan's response to COVID-19 shows how pandemics can be contained
We are fortunate to have many friends in government, the media, and organizations across the world
who have highlighted our pandemic response, as well as what Taiwan can do for the world.

phrases.zh: 以及……、還有……（比 and 正式）

respond.prompt_en: Think of a time when someone helped you, or you helped someone in need. What happened? Answer in one sentence.
respond.prompt_zh: 想一想：有人幫過你，或你幫助過需要幫忙的人嗎？發生了什麼事？用一句英文回答。（可以用 I was fortunate to have… 或 I once helped… who was in need.）

vocab.example: The firefighters contained the fire before it reached the forest.
vocab.note: 蔡英文原句：pandemics can be contained（疫情可以被控制住）。另一個意思「包含」：This drink contains a lot of sugar. ⚠️ 名詞 container＝容器。

vocab.example: I was fortunate to get the last ticket for the concert.
vocab.note: be fortunate to V / be fortunate enough to V。副詞 fortunately（幸好）＝luckily；反義 unfortunate / unfortunately。比 lucky 正式，寫作加分。

vocab.zh: 強調、使受注目；精彩片段
vocab.example: The report highlighted the importance of washing your hands.
vocab.note: 蔡英文原句：who have highlighted our pandemic response。名詞：the highlight of the trip＝旅程最精彩的部分；highlighter＝螢光筆。

vocab.example: Our class collected old clothes for families in need.
vocab.note: 放在名詞後面：people in need、countries in need（同一篇演講：helping countries in need）。諺語 A friend in need is a friend indeed.（患難見真情）

vocab.example: I'm grateful to my sister for helping me with my science project.
vocab.note: ⚠️ 介系詞陷阱：be grateful to＋人＋for＋事。不要和 great 搞混；也不要寫成 greatful（拼字錯）！同義 thankful。

grammar.title: 代名詞陷阱：it / one / some / any / mine（指「同一個」還是「同類的」？）
grammar.explain:
會考低答對率題型（110 會考 find any 答對率只有 41%）。先問自己：空格指的是「哪一個」？
① it＝前面說過的「那一個、同一個」東西。Can I use yours? — I'm not using it now.（就是那塊橡皮擦）
② one＝同類的「任一個」（＝a/an＋名詞）；複數用 ones，或用 some。I lost my pen. Can I borrow one?（任何一支筆都好）
③ some 用在肯定句、提供／請求（Would you like some…? / Can I check… for some tools?）；any 用在否定、疑問、if / whether 後面：See if you can find any.（不確定裡面有沒有 → any）
④ mine / yours / hers＝「my＋名詞」，本身就是主詞或受詞，後面不能再接名詞。I want another dentist because mine (＝my dentist) pulled out a good tooth.
🔑 判斷法：同一個 → it；同類任一個 → one；不確定有沒有 → any；「我的那個」→ mine。
⭐ B2 加分：any 也可以用在肯定句，表示「隨便哪一個都行」：Any student can join the club.
examples: Tom: I need an eraser. Can I use yours? Judy: Sure. I'm not using it now. —— 110 補考：yours＝Judy 的橡皮擦 → 同一塊 → it
My phone is broken, so I'm going to buy a new one. —— one＝同類的另一支手機（不是原本那支，所以不用 it）
Can I check your drawer for some tools? — Sure. See if you can find any in there. —— 110 會考：if（是否）後面不確定有沒有 → any；前面請求句用 some

practice.question: I've lost my umbrella, and it's raining hard. Can you lend me ___?
practice.explanation: umbrella 弄丟了，要借的是「同類的任一把傘」→ one。it 會變成「借我那把（已經弄丟的）傘」；mine 是「我的」，不能叫別人借你「我的」；any 單獨用在這裡不自然（要說 any umbrella）。

uoe.passage: When the typhoon hit the east coast, many families lost their homes. Our class wanted to help people ___1___ need, so we collected food and clothes. I couldn't find ___2___ old jackets in my closet, so I bought a new ___3___ instead. The organizer was very ___4___ for our help and later sent us a thank-you card.

gaps.explanation: people in need＝有需要的人（固定片語，放在名詞後面）。
couldn't 是否定句 → any old jackets（一件都找不到）。some 用在肯定句；it / one 後面不能再接 old jackets。
a new one＝一件新的（同類的外套）。a new it / a new them / a new mine 都不合文法。
be grateful for＋事＝因為……而感激。fortunate 是「幸運的」，不接 for our help；careful、hopeful 意思不合。

quiz.question:
Nora: Can I check your drawer for some tools we can use?
Matt: Sure. Take a look. See if you can find ___ in there.
quiz.explanation: See if＝看看是否 → 不確定抽屜裡有沒有工具 → any（任何可用的工具）。it 指特定一個；others / those 前面沒有對照或特定對象。全國答對率只有約 41%！

quiz.question:
Tom: I need an eraser. Can I use yours?
Judy: Sure. I'm not using ___ now.
quiz.explanation: Tom 要借的就是 Judy 的那塊橡皮擦 → 同一個東西 → it。another＝另一個；each＝每一個；yours＝你的（Judy 不會說「我沒在用你的」）。

quiz.question: I want to find another dentist because ___ pulled out a good tooth last time I went to him.
quiz.explanation: 拔錯好牙的是「我的牙醫」→ mine＝my dentist，當主詞。I 不會自己拔牙還去找 him；me 是受詞、myself 是反身代名詞，都不能當這裡的主詞。

quiz.question: The doctors worked day and night to ___ the disease, so it did not spread to other cities.
quiz.explanation: so it did not spread＝沒有擴散 → 把疾病「控制住」→ contain。contact 聯絡、continue 繼續、complain 抱怨：長得像但意思完全不同（會考常考的形近字陷阱）。

quiz.question: I was ___ to get the last ticket. The man behind me had to go home without one.
quiz.explanation: 買到最後一張票、後面的人沒買到 → 我很「幸運」→ fortunate。順便注意 without one：one＝a ticket（同類的任一張）。

quiz.question: In the clip, what does Tsai Ing-wen say Taiwan's response to COVID-19 shows?
options: Pandemics can only be stopped by closing all schools.
Pandemics can be contained without curtailing democratic freedoms.
Taiwan does not need any friends to fight a pandemic.
Freedom is less important than health.
quiz.explanation: 原句：Taiwan's response to COVID-19 shows how pandemics can be contained without curtailing democratic freedoms.（疫情可以在不限縮民主自由的情況下被控制住。）

dialog.greet: Hi Roby! 我是蔡老師 😊 今天的主題是「互相幫助」，順便破解會考很愛考的 it / one / any / mine 代名詞陷阱。Ready?
dialog.present: 先聽原聲跟讀，再學 5 個單字。今天的口訣：同一個用 it、同類用 one、不確定有沒有用 any！Let's go!
correct: Nice job, Roby! 你分得出「同一個」和「同類的」😎
Spot on! 這種題全國只有四成的人答對，你做到了！
wrong: Not quite. 沒關係，想想看空格指的是「同一個」還是「同類的任一個」💪
Almost! 句子是否定、疑問或 if 嗎？那可能要用 any 喔～
Oops! 錯了也是在學習，再試一次～
dialog.hint: 小提示：同一個 → it；同類任一個 → one；不確定有沒有 → any；我的那個 → mine。
dialog.submit: Ready to check? 送出前再檢查一次喔！
dialog.done: Well done, Roby! 今天的代名詞陷阱你都搞定了 🎉 I'm grateful for your hard work. See you tomorrow!
